patch.why: The Emperor's own ciphered letters to Count Leopold Viktorin von Windischgrätz, one of his envoys, in the years of the Congress of Cambrai; one letter announces a new key.
patch.score_note: Reviewed by hand 19 Sept 2026 from DECODE's metadata and the literature; leaf not viewed. Solvability 5 and difficulty 1 because the key is on DECODE; importance 3 because the content is unknown and probably routine instructions.

note: DECODE's uploader reconstructed the key (homophonic with bigram signs and nulls; Mírka, Západočeské archivy 2012) but uploaded no plaintext: the reading should follow once the key is applied across 106 pages.
